title: Parallel Predictive with new-style prng keys
author: ludaavics

comments.author: ludaavics
comments.body:
I guess a quick work around is to convert to old style keys when calling `predictive`:

```python
posterior_predictive_samples = posterior_predictive(
        jax.random.key_data(key),
        marriage=dset["Marriage"].values,
        divorce=None,
    )
```

Any objections to that as a way to support older version of nunpyro? Any gotcha I might be setting myself up for?

comments.author: juanitorduz
comments.body: Hi @ludaavics , I proposed a fix in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/pull/2073 :) Happy to get feedback.
